name: Waupaca River

gaugeContext.note: This downstream USGS station has no discharge observations in the seven-day API check on November 5, 2026; its published continuous record ends in 2020. It remains a same-river reference, not a live reading or timing calibration for Cobbtown–Brainard’s Bridge.

timing.note: No reviewed flow/speed calibration is available. The county’s published paddling time, access map and correction links remain usable without a live gauge reading.

blurb: A winding Waupaca County paddling trip from Cobbtown Road to Brainard’s Bridge Park, with wooded banks, road crossings and moving-water challenges.

sections.difficulty: Moving water, rocks and occasional whitewater (county guide)
sections.notes: An approximately 8-mile county-guide trip for paddlers with some kayaking experience. Expect rocks, fallen trees and changing current. Arrange a vehicle shuttle between the named access areas; no shuttle service is included.

distanceEvidence.note: Approximate published trip mileage. It is independent of the generalized map line and does not establish a timing calibration.

guideTimes.conditions: Approximate paddling time from the county guide. Flow, obstacles and stops can change the trip duration; this is not a live estimate.

sections.routeReview: Approximate river-course overview. Small bends are generalized and the final 150 metres into the park’s islands and footbridges are not drawn. The takeout marker shows the park area.

putInAccess.operator: Public access — managing agency not specified in county guide
putInAccess.sourceName: Waupaca County — public access facilities and paddling guide
putInAccess.note: County facility 19359 and its paddling guide identify the Cobbtown launch. The unchanged county coordinate agrees with the visible bank-side launch beside the road bend. This is a desktop landing review, not a field survey. A club coordinate farther upstream is a different approach and was not substituted.
putInAccess.directions: Use the public access beside Cobbtown Road just off Highway Q, at the river-side road bend. Park in the designated access area and confirm current signs and water conditions.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Waupaca County — public access facilities and paddling guide
takeOutAccess.note: The county guide ends this trip at Brainard’s Bridge Park, and county GIS lists a public boat access here. Its coordinate lies within the park’s island-and-bridge area, not on a clearly established landing. The marker is an approximate takeout area; choose the signed landing on arrival.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use Brainard’s Bridge Park, 711 Bailey Street in Waupaca. Review the park takeout before launching; the area has islands and footbridges, and this marker does not identify an exact landing channel.

mapAuditNote: County-guide trip with a reviewed Cobbtown landing and approximate Brainard’s Bridge park access. Map availability does not verify an exact takeout connection or live timing.
